d:
A timeless Jassie Gill classic! Bapu Zimidar — from the album Replay (Return Of Melody), out on Speed Records.
Sung by Jassie Gill with lyrics by Happy Raikoti and music by Jatinder Shah, Bapu Zimidar is one of Jassie Gill's most loved songs — a relatable, evergreen track that struck a chord with fans everywhere. Turn it up and enjoy!
Song Credits
Song - Bapu Zimidar
Artist - Jassi Gill
Album - Replay ( Return Of Melody)
Lyrics - Happy Raikoti
Music - Jatinder Shah
